taskDescription: Wave 7: Storage Foundation - Implement SQLite infrastructure and state storage for Skillrunner MVP. This builds on the completed v2.0 implementation (Waves 1-6) which includes domain types, providers, routing, and CLI commands.

features.description: Implement SQLite infrastructure with connection manager and migrations for tables: workspaces, sessions, checkpoints, context_items, rules, drift_log
Create state storage port interfaces: WorkspaceStoragePort, SessionStoragePort, CheckpointStoragePort, ContextItemStoragePort, RuleStoragePort in internal/application/ports/state.go
Implement storage repositories: workspace_repo.go, session_repo.go, checkpoint_repo.go, context_item_repo.go, rules_repo.go in internal/infrastructure/storage/
